settings.description_override: For the Friday departure and the invitation that becomes a weekend away. The Eleanor has the presence of a travel bag with the considered details of a favorite handbag: rolled handles, a broad leather flap and a generous silhouette. It feels as natural beside a wool coat as it does at the end of a sunlit platform.
settings.fact_material: Canvas and vegetable-tanned leather; Black all leather
settings.fact_detail: Made by artisans with 10 years of experience

settings.heading: Details
settings.content: The Eleanor has a broad fold-over flap, rolled top handles and leather corner reinforcements. Cognac, Army Green and Espresso combine canvas with leather; Black has an all-leather exterior. Approximate dimensions are 18 × 14.5 × 7 inches (W × H × D).

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: For Cognac, Army Green and Espresso, spot-clean the canvas carefully with a barely damp cloth and wipe the leather dry. For Black, use a soft, dry cloth across the leather exterior. Allow moisture to dry naturally, away from direct heat, and store loosely filled.

settings.heading: Shipping & delivery
settings.content: Please allow 10 days from your order to dispatch. Delivery time is additional and varies by destination. You will receive tracking details when your order ships. See our shipping policy for delivery information.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.content: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for unused items in their original packaging with tags attached. To arrange a return, contact customerservice@velantrafashion.com. See our return policy for full conditions.
